# FTI Capital Advisors Supports VEON on Strategic Partnership for Telecommunications Infrastructure in Pakistan


Dubai, 10 December 2024 — FTI Capital Advisors (DIFC) Limited (“FTICA Dubai”), a subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc. (NYSE: FCN), acted as sole financial advisor to VEON Ltd. (“VEON”), the parent company of Pakistan's leading digital operator, Jazz, on its strategic partnership with Engro Corporation.


The partnership involves the contribution of 10,617 towers from Deodar Private Limited, a subsidiary of Jazz, to an infrastructure platform owned by Engro Corporation Limited (“Engro Corp”).


The collaboration marks a significant milestone for both parties, aligning with Jazz’s commitment to digital transformation while harnessing Engro’s expertise in infrastructure investments to enhance telecommunications capabilities in Pakistan.


[Fede Membrillera](https://www.fticonsulting.com/experts/federico-membrillera) , Global Co-Leader of FTI Capital Advisors, said: “It was great to be involved in this landmark partnership that highlights Jazz’s commitment to continue advancing connectivity as a pivotal driving force in the country’s digital transformation effort.”


**About FTI Capital Advisors**


FTI Capital Advisors (“FTICA”) is a global M&A advisory firm with offices in 13 countries, focused on M&A, equity and debt raising and independent financial advisory, across targeted industry sectors – including telecom, media and technology, as well as in the energy, financial services, healthcare, aviation & aerospace, industrials and insurance. Backed by the power of FTI Consulting’s worldwide network of professionals, FTICA combines deep industry expertise with investment banking and transaction execution experience to deliver value-enhancing outcomes for our clients. FTI Capital Advisors globally is the wholly owned investment banking subsidiary of FTI Consulting, Inc.


This process was supported by FTI Capital Advisors (DIFC) Limited (“FTICA Dubai”), an affiliate of FTICA. FTICA Dubai is regulated by the Dubai Financial Services Authority (“DFSA”), the financial regulatory agency of the special economic zone, the Dubai International Financial Centre (“DIFC”), in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. FTICA Dubai is authorized to provide services to Professional Clients only; accordingly, this press release is intended for Professional Clients only and no other person should act upon it.
